title: slopvac v3 packs lockfile
description: The .slopvac/packs.lock file. `slopvac plugins sync` writes it and a run reads it. It pins each pack and plugin to a version, a source and a content digest, so a run on another machine loads the same bytes. A digest mismatch makes the run fail with exit 2. The lockfile records no trust: trust is a separate per-user record. Semantics are specified in docs/contract/packs.md. Owner: slopvac-8l4.2.4.

packs.description: Locked entries, sorted by id, so diffs stay small.

Digest.description: sha256 digest of the pack content, as the OCI manifest digest or the hash of the extracted tree.

source.description: An oci:// reference, an https:// release archive URL, a git+https:// URL pinned to a full commit hash after @, or a path relative to the project root. http:// is rejected.

signature.description: Present when the host verified a minisign signature.

not_before.description: The notBefore time of the signed statement, in UTC. `plugins update` refuses an older value than the lockfile holds unless the user passes the downgrade flag.

requires.description: Ids of locked packs this entry needs.
